title: شهری روی صفحه دفتر
logline_fa: روی یک صفحه خط‌دار دفتر، یک خط کج کشیده می‌شود و کم‌کم خانه، خیابان و شهر می‌شود؛ دوربین پیوسته عقب می‌رود تا ببینی همه‌چیز در یک دفتر بوده.

protagonist.what: a hand-drawn line that becomes buildings
protagonist.build: ink draw-on ribbons (drawOn idea from pencil v2), buildings as SVG groups scaling from a baseline pivot; page as ruled-line pattern
protagonist.state_change: one wobbly line -> a house -> a street -> a skyline -> the whole notebook seen from far

beats.what: one line on the page, close-up
line turns into a house, then neighbours sprout
camera zooms out continuously while the city grows on the same page
notebook closes in frame; copy on its cover

payoffs.viewer_gets: page was bigger than thought, city appears
page fold and cover with copy

assets: SVG ruled paper, ink ribbons, seeded building groups, notebook cover
kit sfx: pencil scratch, pop, whoosh, paper rustle, clap

tests: continuous zoom over one scene (no cuts)
100+ small shapes within the DOM budget
transformation of one shape into many
likely_skill_gaps: DOM-node budget: capture speed with 100+ nodes
acceptance: capture fps >= 8 on the zoom section
run-gates: no dead frames during the zoom
transition strip: zoom is monotone, no step
lab.risk: high; node count may slow capture; fallback is canvas for far buildings
